+import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeRedesignIdealPurity
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Finiteness.Ideal
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.AtPrime.Basic
+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Nakayama
+
+/-!
+# Lifting fibre-local principal generation to the total stalk
+
+Let `R → B`, let `q ∈ Spec B`, and put `p = q ∩ R`.  If `J ⊆ B` is
+finitely generated and `B / J` is flat over `R`, then principal generation
+of `J` near `q` in the fibre over `p` lifts to principal generation in the
+total local ring `B_q`.
+
+The fibre input below is deliberately stated in denominator-cleared form:
+for every `x ∈ J`, there is `r ∉ q` such that
+
+`r * x ∈ (e) + pB`.
+
+This is exactly the elementwise form of the localized fibre containment
+
+`J_q ⊆ (e) + p B_q`.
+
+Flatness of `B / J` gives the purity identity `J ∩ pB = pJ`.  Consequently,
+after localizing and quotienting `J_q` by `(e)`, the displayed containment
+becomes `J_q / (e) = p (J_q / (e))`.  Since `p B_q` lies in the maximal ideal
+and `J_q` is finite, Nakayama gives `J_q = (e)`.  The final statement clears
+the localization denominator again.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+universe u
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry
+
+namespace FibreToStalkFlat
+
+open scoped TensorProduct
+
+variable {R B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
+
+/-! ## The flat-quotient intersection identity -/
+
+/-- If `B / J` is flat over `R`, an element of `J` which lies in the extension
+of an `R`-ideal `p` already lies in `pJ` (viewed first as the `R`-submodule
+`p • J`).  This is the elementwise content of `J ∩ pB = pJ`. -/
+theorem mem_smul_top_of_mem_map_of_flat_quotient
+    (J : Ideal B) [Module.Flat R (B ⧸ J)] (p : Ideal R) (x : J)
+    (hx : (x : B) ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R B) p) :
+    x ∈ p • (⊤ : Submodule R J) := by
+  have hzeroAmbient :
+      ((J.restrictScalars R).subtype.lTensor (R ⧸ p))
+          ((1 : R ⧸ p) ⊗ₜ[R] x) = 0 := by
+    rw [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul]
+    apply (TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul B p).injective
+    rw [map_zero, TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul_mk_one_tmul,
+      Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Ideal.smul_top_eq_map]
+    exact hx
+  have hzero : ((1 : R ⧸ p) ⊗ₜ[R] x) = 0 :=
+    (IdealPurity.subtype_lTensor_injective_of_flat_quotient
+      (R := R) (B := B) J (R ⧸ p)) hzeroAmbient
+  have hmk :
+      (Submodule.Quotient.mk x : J ⧸ (p • (⊤ : Submodule R J))) = 0 := by
+    rw [← TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul_mk_one_tmul]
+    rw [hzero, map_zero]
+  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hmk
+  exact hmk
+
+/-- Ideal-valued form of
+`mem_smul_top_of_mem_map_of_flat_quotient`: `J ∩ pB ⊆ (pB)J`. -/
+theorem mem_map_mul_of_mem_map_of_flat_quotient
+    (J : Ideal B) [Module.Flat R (B ⧸ J)] (p : Ideal R) (x : J)
+    (hx : (x : B) ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R B) p) :
+    (x : B) ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R B) p * J := by
+  have hp := mem_smul_top_of_mem_map_of_flat_quotient
+    (R := R) (B := B) J p x hx
+  refine Submodule.smul_induction_on hp (fun r hr y _ ↦ ?_) (fun y z hy hz ↦ ?_)
+  · simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using
+      Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap R B) hr) y.2
+  · exact (Ideal.map (algebraMap R B) p * J).add_mem hy hz
+
+/-! ## Fibre-to-stalk lifting -/
+
+variable {L : Type u} [CommRing L] [Algebra B L] [Algebra R L]
+variable [IsScalarTower R B L]
+
+/-- **Fibre-to-total-stalk lift.**
+
+The hypothesis `hfibre` is the denominator-cleared version of fibre-local
+generation at `q`: every `x ∈ J` becomes a sum of a multiple of `e` and an
+element from the contracted base prime after multiplication by some element
+outside `q`.  Flatness of `B / J` converts the base-prime summand into `pJ`,
+and local Nakayama removes it.
+
+The conclusion is likewise denominator-cleared: it says precisely that the
+image of every `x ∈ J` in `B_q` belongs to the principal ideal generated by
+the image of `e`. -/
+theorem exists_notMem_mul_mem_span_singleton_of_fibre_of_flat_quotient_of_isLocalization
+    (q : PrimeSpectrum B) [IsLocalization.AtPrime L q.asIdeal]
+    (J : Ideal B) (hJfg : J.FG) [Module.Flat R (B ⧸ J)]
+    (e : B) (he : e ∈ J)
+    (hfibre : ∀ x : J, ∃ r : B, r ∉ q.asIdeal ∧
+      r * (x : B) ∈
+        Ideal.span ({e} : Set B) ⊔
+          Ideal.map (algebraMap R B)
+            (Ideal.comap (algebraMap R B) q.asIdeal)) :
+    ∀ x : J, ∃ r : B, r ∉ q.asIdeal ∧
+      r * (x : B) ∈ Ideal.span ({e} : Set B) := by
+  letI : IsLocalRing L :=
+    IsLocalization.AtPrime.isLocalRing L q.asIdeal
+  let p : Ideal R := Ideal.comap (algebraMap R B) q.asIdeal
+  let JL : Ideal L := Ideal.map (algebraMap B L) J
+  let E : Ideal L := Ideal.span ({algebraMap B L e} : Set L)
+  let I : Ideal L := Ideal.map (algebraMap R L) p
+  have hImax : I ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L := by
+    change Ideal.map (algebraMap R L) p ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L
+    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
+    intro r hr
+    change algebraMap R L r ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L
+    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R B L]
+    exact (IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff
+      L q.asIdeal (algebraMap R B r)).2 hr
+  have hIjac : I ≤ (⊥ : Ideal L).jacobson :=
+    hImax.trans (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_le_jacobson ⊥)
+  have hlocal : JL ≤ E ⊔ I * JL := by
+    change Ideal.map (algebraMap B L) J ≤ E ⊔ I * JL
+    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
+    intro x hx
+    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrx⟩ := hfibre ⟨x, hx⟩
+    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hrx
+    have haJ : a ∈ J :=
+      (Ideal.span_le.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr he)) ha
+    have hbJ : b ∈ J := by
+      have hbeq : b = r * x - a := by rw [← hab]; ring
+      rw [hbeq]
+      exact J.sub_mem (J.mul_mem_left r hx) haJ
+    have hbMul : b ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R B) p * J :=
+      mem_map_mul_of_mem_map_of_flat_quotient
+        (R := R) (B := B) J p ⟨b, hbJ⟩ hb
+    have hma : algebraMap B L a ∈ E := by
+      have := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap B L) ha
+      simpa [E, Ideal.map_span] using this
+    have hmb : algebraMap B L b ∈ I * JL := by
+      have := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap B L) hbMul
+      simpa [I, JL, p, Ideal.map_mul, Ideal.map_map,
+        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R B L] using this
+    have hrxLocal :
+        algebraMap B L r * algebraMap B L x ∈ E ⊔ I * JL := by
+      have habLocal := congrArg (algebraMap B L) hab
+      rw [map_add, map_mul] at habLocal
+      rw [← habLocal]
+      exact Submodule.add_mem _
+        (Submodule.mem_sup_left hma) (Submodule.mem_sup_right hmb)
+    have hrUnit : IsUnit (algebraMap B L r) :=
+      IsLocalization.map_units L (⟨r, hr⟩ : q.asIdeal.primeCompl)
+    exact (Ideal.unit_mul_mem_iff_mem (E ⊔ I * JL) hrUnit).mp hrxLocal
+  have hNak : (JL : Submodule L L) ≤ (E : Submodule L L) := by
+    apply Submodule.le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot
+      (hJfg.map (algebraMap B L)) hIjac
+    simpa only [Ideal.smul_eq_mul] using hlocal
+  intro x
+  have hxLocal :
+      algebraMap B L (x : B) ∈
+        Ideal.map (algebraMap B L) (Ideal.span ({e} : Set B)) := by
+    have hxJL : algebraMap B L (x : B) ∈ JL := by
+      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap B L) x.2
+    have hxE : algebraMap B L (x : B) ∈ E := hNak hxJL
+    simpa [E, Ideal.map_span] using hxE
+  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrx⟩ :=
+    (IsLocalization.algebraMap_mem_map_algebraMap_iff
+      q.asIdeal.primeCompl L (Ideal.span ({e} : Set B)) (x : B)).mp hxLocal
+  exact ⟨r, hr, hrx⟩
+
+/-- The specialization of
+`exists_notMem_mul_mem_span_singleton_of_fibre_of_flat_quotient_of_isLocalization`
+to mathlib's canonical localization `B_q`.  This is the convenient form for
+callers: no choice of a localization model occurs in its statement. -/
+theorem exists_notMem_mul_mem_span_singleton_of_fibre_of_flat_quotient
+    (q : PrimeSpectrum B) (J : Ideal B) (hJfg : J.FG)
+    [Module.Flat R (B ⧸ J)] (e : B) (he : e ∈ J)
+    (hfibre : ∀ x : J, ∃ r : B, r ∉ q.asIdeal ∧
+      r * (x : B) ∈
+        Ideal.span ({e} : Set B) ⊔
+          Ideal.map (algebraMap R B)
+            (Ideal.comap (algebraMap R B) q.asIdeal)) :
+    ∀ x : J, ∃ r : B, r ∉ q.asIdeal ∧
+      r * (x : B) ∈ Ideal.span ({e} : Set B) := by
+  let L := Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal
+  exact
+    exists_notMem_mul_mem_span_singleton_of_fibre_of_flat_quotient_of_isLocalization
+      (R := R) (B := B) (L := L) q J hJfg e he hfibre
+
+end FibreToStalkFlat
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry
